title: Keep per-instance output within its directory

context.surface: An installation CLI uses configured names when generating local files and cluster configuration.
assumptions: Use disposable local fixtures and synthetic inputs.

review.invariant: Instance identifiers are validated as names before the installer derives output directories.
review.verification: Check approved and rejected synthetic names, including normal names containing dots. Verify that generated paths stay in the instance directory.

source_observation.summary: The baseline failed the new rejection assertions. The repaired installer preserved accepted names and kept generated output in its intended directory.
